papers.title: Stochastic Expectation Propagation for Large Scale Gaussian Process Classification
papers.abstract: A method for large scale Gaussian process classification has been recently proposed based on expectation propagation (EP). Such a method allows Gaussian process classifiers to be trained on very large datasets that were out of the reach of previous deployments of EP and has been shown to be competitive with related techniques based on stochastic variational inference. Nevertheless, the memory resources required scale linearly with the dataset size, unlike in variational methods. This is a severe limitation when the number of instances is very large. Here we show that this problem is avoided when stochastic EP is used to train the model.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及大规模高斯过程分类方法，与有限元代理建模或生物力学优化无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper presents a stochastic EP method for Gaussian process classification, with no application to expensive simulation sampling, no treatment of constraints or uncertainty quantification for surrogate modeling, and no transferability to implant or biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 大规模高斯过程分类的内存瓶颈需要解决
summary_zh.method: 使用随机期望传播降低内存需求
summary_zh.result: 随机EP可避免线性内存增长，适用于大规模数据
summary_zh.validation: 无实验验证，仅算法分析

summary_en.motivation: Memory scaling in large-scale Gaussian process classification limits applicability to very large datasets.
summary_en.method: Stochastic expectation propagation is employed to reduce memory requirements while maintaining classification performance.
summary_en.result: The proposed method avoids linear memory scaling with dataset size, enabling training on extremely large datasets.
summary_en.validation: No experimental validation; only theoretical and algorithmic analysis are provided.

papers.title: Kernel Methods for Accurate UWB-Based Ranging with Reduced Complexity
papers.abstract: Accurate and robust positioning in multipath environments can enable many applications, such as search-and-rescue and asset tracking. For this problem, ultra-wideband (UWB) technology can provide the most accurate range estimates, which are required for range-based positioning. However, UWB still faces a problem with non-line-of-sight (NLOS) measurements, in which the range estimates based on time-of-arrival (TOA) will typically be positively biased. There are many techniques that address this problem, mainly based on NLOS identification and NLOS error mitigation algorithms. However, these techniques do not exploit all available information in the UWB channel impulse response. Kernel-based machine learning methods, such as Gaussian Process Regression (GPR), are able to make use of all information, but they may be too complex in their original form. In this paper, we propose novel ranging methods based on kernel principal component analysis (kPCA), in which the selected channel parameters are projected onto a nonlinear orthogonal high-dimensional space, and a subset of these projections is then used as an input for ranging. We evaluate the proposed methods using real UWB measurements obtained in a basement tunnel, and found that one of the proposed methods is able to outperform state-of-the-art, even if little training samples are available.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及超宽带测距和核方法，与有限元代理建模和生物力学工程方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on UWB-based positioning and NLOS error mitigation, with no connection to FEA, surrogate modeling, or biomechanical design.

summary_zh.motivation: 利用核方法提高UWB测距精度并降低复杂度
summary_zh.method: 提出基于核主成分分析（kPCA）的测距方法，将信道参数投影到高维空间
summary_zh.result: 所提方法在真实地下室隧道测量中优于现有技术，且小样本下表现良好
summary_zh.validation: 使用真实UWB测量数据实验验证

summary_en.motivation: To improve UWB ranging accuracy and reduce complexity using kernel methods.
summary_en.method: Proposes ranging methods based on kernel PCA that project selected channel parameters onto a nonlinear orthogonal high-dimensional space.
summary_en.result: The proposed method outperforms state-of-the-art in real UWB measurements obtained in a basement tunnel, even with few training samples.
summary_en.validation: Validation performed using real UWB measurements in a basement tunnel environment.

papers.title: Morbid Obesity and Congestive Heart Failure Increase Operative Time and Room Time in Total Hip Arthroplasty
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Orthopaedics and Rehabilitation, University of Iowa Hospitals and Clinics, Iowa City, Iowa

corresponding_authors.name: J. Joseph Gholson
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Orthopaedics and Rehabilitation, University of Iowa Hospitals and Clinics, Iowa City, Iowa

llm.relevance_to_user: 与用户方向（髋关节植入物生物力学）无关，仅涉及手术时间临床因素，无任何力学分析
llm.why_not_core: No biomechanics modeling, no stress shielding analysis, no micromotion quantification, no implant design or FEA

summary_zh.motivation: 研究肥胖和心衰对全髋置换手术时间的影响
summary_zh.method: 回顾性分析患者数据，比较不同并发症组的手术时间
summary_zh.result: 肥胖和心衰显著增加手术时间和占用时间

summary_en.motivation: To investigate how morbid obesity and congestive heart failure affect operative and room time in total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: Retrospective analysis of patient records comparing surgical times across comorbidity groups.
summary_en.result: Both morbid obesity and congestive heart failure significantly increased operative and room times.
